name: Orcadian Energy Plc
summary: Orcadian Energy Plc, an enterprise focusing on oil and gas development, operates in the United Kingdom through its main company and affiliated entities. The firm possesses a portfolio of four licenses. A cornerstone of its assets is the Pilot Field, in which Orcadian Energy holds a complete 100% ownership stake. This significant field is estimated to contain 79 million barrels of independently audited proven and probable reserves. Established in 2014, the company's primary operational base is situated in London, United Kingdom.
